verdict.rationale: Riveter lets developers define extraction with a natural-language prompt plus named attributes, and it generates structured columns (docs-2, docs-12). Its AI agents read pages the way a person would rather than relying on selectors, so configurations survive redesigns (docs-15). The API also advertises extracting data from complicated websites (docs-26). However, the evidenced flow is row-based enrichment, and the scrape endpoint only returns parseable text (docs-3). Missing for 10: a documented single-page extract endpoint with schema/output-format details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction accuracy.
